title: release-create
description: Adds a signed agent release to the update store (docs/spec/07-upgrade-channel.md step 3): the manifest exactly as the pipeline signed it, and its detached signature. The server checks the signature against the release keys it knows of; the package zip follows in a second request and must match the manifest's hash and size. None of this is the protection: each agent checks everything again against its own compiled-in key. A release is one version for one Windows architecture (docs/spec/18-built-designs.md §1): the architecture is declared here, and the package's own programs are read to make sure it really is that one, because it cannot live in the signed manifest - that schema is closed and every already-installed agent validates it.

manifest.description: Base64 of the manifest's exact bytes.

architecture.description: Which Windows this release's programs are built for. The package that follows must really be built for it - the server reads the .exe programs inside the zip - and the release is only ever offered to cabinets of this same architecture.

stepUpToken.description: A one-time step-up token bound to this exact action.
